district: City and County of San Francisco
summary: A Yes vote allows private vehicles on the portion of the Great Highway within Sunset Dunes Park.

transit.text: Measure G would reopen the Great Highway to vehicle traffic on weekdays while keeping it car-free on weekends and holidays.
transit.quote: The Great Highway reopens to vehicle traffic Monday through Friday, while weekends and holidays remain a car-free park for recreation.

transit.text: The No on G campaign opposes reopening the Upper Great Highway to cars and supports preserving it as Sunset Dunes Park.
transit.quote: Vote NO on G to Save Sunset Dunes Park!
